Nu:Tekt NTS-1 digital kit — your oscillators

These are .ntkdigunit files for the original NTS-1, not the mkII.
The minilogue xd Sound Librarian will not load them.
Only one oscillator plays at a time. Pick it on the panel after the send.

Slot  File  Sound
   0  nts1_tr808_kick.ntkdigunit  Phonk 808 kick
   1  nts1_west_coast_moog.ntkdigunit  P-Funk / West Coast
   2  nts1_juno_rnb.ntkdigunit  Juno 80s R&B
   3  nts1_dilla_bass.ntkdigunit  Dilla hip-hop bass
   4  nts1_sub_phatty.ntkdigunit  Sub Phatty
   5  nts1_prophet_funk.ntkdigunit  Prophet funk / R&B
   6  nts1_dx7_lately.ntkdigunit  DX7 Lately Bass
   7  nts1_sh101_babyface.ntkdigunit  SH-101 pulse bass
   8  nts1_voyager_se.ntkdigunit  Voyager / SE squelch
   9  nts1_cardo_gfunk.ntkdigunit  Cardo G-funk
  10  nts1_larry_june.ntkdigunit  Larry June cruise
  11  nts1_khalifa_haze.ntkdigunit  Hazy stoner sub
  12  nts1_memphis_juicy.ntkdigunit  Three 6 / Memphis trunk
  13  nts1_ensoniq_eps1.ntkdigunit  Ensoniq EPS Memphis

On the NTS-1: USB connected, power on.
Then from this repo run:
  powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File tools\load-nts1.ps1
Turn the oscillator TYPE control to the user slot you want.
